slug: 2026-01-22 Burundi launches online tax system e-KORI

facts.fact: The Office Burundais des Recettes will roll out the e-KORI online tax and non-tax revenue platform in nine phases, each deliverable validated before the next, with World Bank support.
The OBR launched the e-KORI platform for online tax filing and the payment of taxes and fees on 19 January 2026.

systems.platform: online tax and non-tax revenue platform
